## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `4ae825d51d9b64f5b6a47786bb1d545eeba0e995`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md, .claude/agents/os-dev.md + none
Security-touching: no
Rule-change-verified: yes

Inputs read: card #35813 (body, 5 comments), card #35905 (body, 4 comments), ruling records 7035727071 and 7046610679, PR #36213 body, file list and net diff (4 files, +19 −15; PR base equals `origin/main` at `1d060265`), the check-runs on the head. Cited text was read on `origin/main`; nothing was built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

- No accept-set and no public-surface change: all four files are internal instruction text under `.claude/**`; no package, schema, export or error code is touched. Right.
- Face: governed rules text, so the review is owed at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` with ④. All four paths are `hits`; the diff holds no implementing file (no script, gate or ratchet row moves), so the implementing set is `none`. Right.
- Check-runs on the head: every run that executed concluded `success` (Lint and Repo Gates and its twelve lint jobs including PM dispatch-gates, the four Type Check jobs, Test Core, Test UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, PR-body guards); the rest are `skipped` by path filter. No red, nothing pending.
- Security: the hits are under `.claude/**`, not `skills/**`; no changed hunk teaches permission, sharing, credential, token or authentication behaviour. Cut 11 drops a parenthetical naming a hook, not a security rule.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no` holds. `.claude/**` publishes nothing; the `skip-changeset` label is on the PR and `Check Changeset` is green. No changeset is owed and none is present. `Metadata-protocol: none` holds.

### ③ Boundary flags

- SQL push-down: not applicable, no code in the diff.
- Dev `open_questions` (how items 1 and 3 of #35905 reach `references/project-forms.md`, 220 bytes short at headroom 0): not answerable in review. Both ruling records say they order no byte-ceiling raise, so option A needs the maintainer or a seat-carried ruling; ESCALATED to the seat as the dev asked. The PR correctly says `Part of #35905` and binds only `Fixes #35813`; #35905 stays open and its `pm:dispatched` stays until the other half lands.
- Dev deviation, `no os-dev sub-agent` written for every card thread and not only p1: accepted as wording, not a new rule. On `main` the section already reads `coordinator 调度卡线程(即 dev)` and `线程实施`, and card #35905's problem statement calls a card thread starting an `os-dev` sub-agent the opposite of that section.
- Dev deviation, hand-back line placed under the roles line because of open PR #36205: accepted; #36205 adds two lines after the claim lines and nothing in it contradicts this diff. #36209 touches `area-lease.md` lines 39 to 51 only, no overlap with the three hunks here. Whichever of #36205 and this PR lands second pays bytes again in `dispatch-runbook.md` (headroom 2 here).
- Dev out-of-scope note, confirmed on `main`: `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` (the `--brief-template` header at line 2670, and the jsdoc at line 869 saying the dispatching seat runs the review in its own seat) names only the seat and the card thread; under the new p1 path the L1 thread hands the brief too. Outside the diff and not reviewed; a follow-up card for the seat, no carrier yet.
- The 13 restatement cuts, each fact checked for a live home (on `main`, or kept by this diff):
  1. Heading parenthetical: `按面` stays in the title and first rule line; the charter pointer stays in SKILL.md lane table (line 173) and in the routing line of the same section. The ten script citations spell the heading as 〈L2 归属与资格〉 and still match. Holds.
  2. Prose-face sentence: `l1-review-checklist.md` line 19 carries `逐句核 diff,ACCEPT 点名所核句,⛔ 不起子代理` for the same three faces; SKILL.md 〈审核两级〉 keeps L1 with the dispatching seat or its L1 thread. Holds.
  3. `PASS 同笔摘标记、FAIL 不摘`: `contract-review.md` 〈等 L2 标记〉 摘 line. Holds.
  4. `卡线程照计 batch`: SKILL.md entry table `batch` row (one slot is one running sub-agent or card thread). Holds.
  5. `线程核对最新认领指向本分支方开工`: AGENTS.md claim paragraph (a dispatched executor verifies the newest claim names its branch and stops on a mismatch). Holds.
  6. `线程只能推指定分支是实测平台例外,认领如实写`: `os-dev.md` rule 1 (`卡线程分支由平台指定、harness 推送`) and the kept runbook line `带该 Branch: 的认领`. Holds.
  7. `--tier 过路径,MANDATORY 即绑;effort 按难度`: `execution-duties.md` lines 101 and 125, `coordinator.md` section 四 line 36, SKILL.md claim template line 318; the next runbook line keeps the derivation wording. Holds.
  8. `lanes/l2-review.md 席规不及它`: SKILL.md 〈审核两级〉 line 51. Holds.
  9. `信箱只留跨账号或跨项目`: `lanes/l2-review.md` line 13, verbatim, for requests to an L1 or L2 seat. Holds.
  10. `Branch: 照 AGENTS.md 命名`: AGENTS.md multi-agent discipline rule 2. Holds.
  11. `(PreToolUse 钩子会拦)`: AGENTS.md Prime Directive 11. Holds.
  12. `,仍以本文件为准`: the head of the same sentence. Holds.
  13. Footer sentence: AGENTS.md attribution paragraph (line 444) carries both halves; the kept pointer `完整读数住 AGENTS.md 同条` still resolves through the bullet above the code block. Holds.
  No cut is left without a home, and none removes a rule.

### ④ Design judgment

Rule-changing hunks, each checked against the ruling words it cites:

- `contract-review.md`, new line `p1 卡线程卡交回且欠 L2 ⇒ L1 线程起隔离 L2 子代理,与其 L1 并行,两份意见同回席`: copies record 7035727071 (the chosen option's consequence `卡线程自己写代码,审核线程做 L1 并起 L2,座位落地`, made standing by `是所有 p1 都按照新规则执行`). It is narrower than the ruling in one respect only (p1 cards that go to a card thread; an S p1 card stays a sub-agent), which is what the card states and adds no rule. Holds against the file: the default `谁跑 = 派发席` line stays directly above, tier evidence for a sub-agent is the output file as before, and starting L2 beside L1 means no L1 conclusion exists to leak into the brief.
- `contract-review.md`, adoption line extended to `卡线程或 L1 线程隔离子代理`: the consequence of the same ruling (the seat adopts and lands). The brief, the `Scope:` check and the independence pair are the same sentence as before. Holds.
- `dispatch-runbook.md`, roles line `线程自己实施 … ⛔ 不起 os-dev 子代理` and the hand-back line: copy `卡线程自己写代码` and the same hand-back path. Consistent with the other two files. Holds.
- `area-lease.md`, L1 thread line: same rule, in the only place the L1 thread's duties live (no `lanes/l1-review.md` exists on `main`). Does not contradict the 送审 line of 〈区内规则〉. Holds.
- `dispatch-runbook.md`, `线程或区见令缺推导 ⇒ 不开工,退回席位;⛔ 不凭记忆补档位`: copies item 2 of #35905 as ordered by record 7046610679, word for word, and sits under the line that requires the derivation in the order. Holds.
- `os-dev.md` mirror: see S1.

S1 (should-fix) — `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`, 〈何时停手不写码〉, the mirror line drops the ruled subject. The ruled line is `a thread or area that finds its dispatch order missing a derivation`, and the mirror was ordered because a card thread reads `os-dev.md`. As written (`派发令缺档位或 effort 的推导 ⇒ 不开工,退回席位`) it binds every reader of `os-dev.md`, including an ordinary `mode:subagent` or `mode:cloud` dev. On `main` only the card-thread section requires the derivation in the order (`派发令写两者与推导`); a sub-agent order owes tier and effort (`execution-duties.md` line 125) and the claim template asks for a cited reading only at `xhigh`, so a conforming sub-agent order with `effort: high` and no difficulty reading would now be refused by its dev. That reaches past the ruled words, and it is why the rule-change line above reads `yes` on this head. Fix: scope the line the way rule 1 of the same file scopes its thread-only sentence, for example `卡线程见令缺档位或 effort 的推导 ⇒ 不开工,退回席位;⛔ 不凭记忆补档位。` (about 6 bytes more; the file has headroom 18). With that, every rule-changing hunk copies its ruling and the delta can read `ruled`.

N1 (nit) — the three p1 lines name the L1 thread without saying what a seat with no L1 thread does (a seat under the partition threshold has none). The default `谁跑 = 派发席` line above covers it and the ruling itself speaks of the review thread, so the contract is intact; accepted deviation, no fix asked.

No must-fix. One should-fix, S1, open on this head.
